copy.tagline: Three laps, eight karts, one finish line.
copy.description: The first 3D game on PLAYNEX. Lap a winding track against three bots or race up to eight people in an online room. Online races run the driving model on the server; your own kart responds without delay and rivals catch up smoothly.
controls: W or the up arrow accelerates, S or the down arrow brakes and reverses.
Steer with A/D or the left/right arrows; space drifts through sharp turns.
Gamepad: left stick steers, RT accelerates, LT brakes, A drifts.
On a touch screen, use the buttons in the bottom corners.
Karts slow down off the track; the first to finish three laps wins.
